verdict.rationale: Claude ships official, documented integration points for coding agents and frameworks: Messages API with tool use/parallel tool calling, an MCP connector and MCP tunnels for connecting to remote/private MCP servers, Agent Skills (pre-built and custom), a Claude Code agent harness, official client SDKs across seven languages, and a CLI. This directly satisfies the 'skills, plugins, or first-class SDK support' story with first-party docs. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of third-party agent-framework integrations (e.g. LangChain, AutoGPT) beyond Anthropic's own docs.
